profile.purpose: Configure 100 ESMFold2 native whole-surface binder designs with ESMFold2-Fast folding and scoring. The native route generates backbone and sequence together. This profile runs the route unaimed, and the adapter's epitope aiming is available but unmeasured.
profile.production_scoring_reason: The ESMFold2 native-design runtime requires operator-confirmed source, checkpoint, environment, hardware, network, and step values before dispatch.

native_design_aiming.note: This profile runs the route unaimed. It passes --acknowledge-unaimed and supplies no epitope residues, so the interface contact loss averages over the whole target surface. The adapter does support aiming, so a campaign that wants a chosen site changes this profile rather than the tool. ESMFold2-Fast scoring remains configured after generation.

native_design_operator_values.runtime_resources: __REQUIRED__ operator-selected CPU, memory, and GPU request
native_design_operator_values.critic_num_sampling_steps: __REQUIRED__ native design critic sampling step count

published_predictor_deviations.reason: This profile removes the inherited esmfold2-predictor adapter and its screen and rescore stages. The full-mode deployment revision, model revision, and environment identity are unmeasured. This profile runs ESMFold2-Fast only.

This profile removes the inherited protenix-v2-predictor adapter and its screen and rescore stages. Protenix v2 has no measured runnable deployment for this package. This profile runs ESMFold2-Fast only.

disabled_caps.maximum_fraction_per_generator: The profile configures one whole-surface native design generator.
disabled_caps.max_structure_method_fraction: The profile configures one native structure method.
disabled_caps.max_seq_method_fraction: The profile configures one native sequence-design method.
